messages.subject: Re: Want to specify legend without specifying colour in qplot()
parts:
Hi Harini,

You need to approach this slightly differently:

qplot(variable1, variable2, data, size = variable2)+
geom_point(aes(colour = "points")) +
geom_jitter(aes(colour = "jittered", shape = 1) +
geom_smooth(se = F)

And then adjust the legend using scale_colour_manual.

Hadley
